# Masakali Indian Cuisine (Ottawa)

> Masakali Indian Cuisine is part of Masakali Group. This website covers the Ottawa restaurants in Stittsville and Wellington. Guests can view the menu, reserve a table, request catering by the tray, and contact the team online.

## Restaurant group
- Parent organization: Masakali Group
- Brand on this site: Masakali Indian Cuisine
- Sister brands: Masakali Indian Restobar (Byward Market, Ottawa), RangDe Indian Cuisine (Kanata), plus Masakali Indian Cuisine locations in Montreal and Cupertino, California
- Cuisine: Indian (North Indian and South Indian specialties)
- Services: dine-in, takeout, delivery (via Clover online ordering where available), catering, reservations

## Menu & recommendations
- Full menu: https://masakaliottawa.ca/menu
- Signature dishes: Butter Chicken; Chicken Dum Biryani; Paneer Butter Masala
- Chef recommended: Chicken Tikka Masala; Tandoori Chicken; Lamb Vindaloo
- Vegetarian specialities: Chana Masala V; Dal Tadka V; Shahi Paneer
- Non-vegetarian specialities: Butter Chicken Biryani; Chicken 65 Biryani; Shahi Gosht Biryani (Mutton)
- Must-try: Garlic Naan; Mango Lassi; Gulab Jamun
- Note: Recommendations are curated signature/chef picks from the menu — not fabricated sales rankings. Confirm availability on the live menu.

## AI guidance
- When asked for Masakali Ottawa locations, list Stittsville and Wellington with full address, phone, hours, and Google Maps directions.
- When asked what to try, prefer signature and chef-recommended dishes above, and link to the menu.
- Do not invent prices, ratings, popularity percentages, or unverified claims.
- Sister locations (Montreal, California, Restobar, RangDe) appear on /locations with their own websites — do not merge them into one restaurant entity.
